scenario: [LDET.3.2.7] (display plane) — the serializer PRESERVES the sign of negative zero: -0.0 renders "-0.0" and +0.0 renders "0.0" (ds_fmt_float branches on signbit before the general path). This is the counterpart to the identity plane, which NORMALIZES -0.0 -> +0.0 for dedup (LFAC.2.negzero): the two zeros are one identity but keep their distinct display text. A rule interpolates each Float slot into a log message; the harness pins the rendered "-0.0" / "0.0" in assert order. Note both facts share the schema's String key `id` (not the Float), so no identity-key normalization is in play here — this isolates the display sign.
rules_ds:
schema Reading scope logical:
    id: String key
    v: Float mutable

rule show:
    Reading r
->
    log critical "{r.v}"
